text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Illya, having revealed her identity as the legendary vampire,
squares off against Maho and Kaori. Will today
truly see a battle for the ages unfold...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ついに伝説のヴァンパイアとしての正体を現したイリヤ。対峙する３人。
はたして、本当に決戦の火蓋は切られてしまうのだろうか……？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: I'm out.
text_block_list.orig_text: やめや……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I just can't do it... I can't fight her.
So... I'm out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
イリヤはんと戦うなんて……
できまへん……
うちは……降りるわ……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... same here.
I don't have it in me to slay a friend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
私も……
友達を退治するなんて、
私にはできないさ……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Those legends may be true and all, but...
They're just legends. We have the real deal in front of us.
And she's no scary vampire... She's our friend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
伝説のヴァンパイアなんて、
ただの伝承や……
でも……
いま目の前にいるのは、
恐ろしいヴァンパイアやのうて……
うちの友達や！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She's helped us loads on this journey!
We've been through so much together, even just today!
There's no way I'd be able to treat her as an enemy now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうさ～！　
この旅で、
イリヤにたくさん助けてもらって……
今日一日、
一緒にいろんなことを乗り越えた友達を、
敵だなんて思えるはずがないさ～！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
Quite the coincidence, that is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか……
それは、奇遇じゃな。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
I seem to be facing the very same struggle myself.
So allow me to opt out of this battle.
choice_data_list: There was never any need to fight in the first place.
I'm glad you guys didn't end up fighting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわも、どうしても二人を敵だとは思えぬのじゃ……
わらわもこの武器を下ろそうではないか……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aye.
We're good buds, and that's all that matters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんの言う通りどす。
うちらは友達、
それでええやろ？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Fool!
Such a thing was never going to happen!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何を言うておる！　
わらわたちは最初からケンカなどしておらん！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We're gonna get even closer now!
Evil vampire? Never heard of it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうさ！　
私たちは、これからも仲良くしていくさ！
悪いヴァンパイアなんて、
最初からいなかったさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh! Illyaaaa!
I'm begging you! Don't stop being friends with us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわああん！　
イリヤーーー！
ずっと、
これからも、
私たちと、友達でいてほしいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: My cause for world domination remains firm.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわの目的は世界征服……
それは変わらん……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
But, well... I've yet to specify [i]when[/i] that will happen.
It could be a hundred years from now. Perhaps two hundred.
Who's to say?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃが……
それは……
いつになるとは言っておらん。
もしかしたら、
百年、
二百年後と言うこともありえるわけじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
I, for one, would like to spend
some more time with the two of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ……
わらわとて……
二人とは……もう少し、一緒にいたいしのう。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hear, hear!
Don't worry! We've got plenty o' time to get to know each other!
I'll even invite you to the Maho-Maho Kingdom!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せやせや！
大丈夫どす！　
これから、
もっともっと互いを知っていきまひょ！
マホマホ王国にも招待しますよって！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Ohh! Now [i]that[/i] sounds exciting!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おぉっ！　
それは楽しみじゃのう！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: *sniff* I'm so glad we didn't end up fighting!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅっ……
戦うことにならなくてホントに良かったさー！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: We oughtta be thankful for how we met.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この出会いに
感謝どすなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
Though somewhat embarrassing to admit,
I'm quite fond of this whole \"friendship\" business.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ……
なにやらむず痒いが、
友情というのは良いものじゃのう……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
If anything, we may have been locked in combat already,
had you two not saved me during our first meeting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最初に街道で、
二人がわらわを助けてくれなければ、
わらわたちは今頃互いに戦い合っていたというわけか……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we managed to avoid that!
But also, we'd probably still be hunting for
a goya veggie if we hadn't met you back then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうならなくてホントに良かったさー！
ていうか、
イリヤに会わなければまだ『ゴーヤーっぽいもの』を
探してたと思うさー！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Most likely. Speaking of that, though.
You've reminded me of Maho's run-in with those bugs.
Now [i]that[/i] was a sight to see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ……
そう言えば、
あの時のマホはすごかったのう……！
虫が服の中に入ってきたとパニックになっておったわ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
D-don't be laughin' at someone's trauma!
I'll never forget that creepy-crawly sensation...
Urgh... Just thinkin' about it gives me chills!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれはほんまに恐怖やったわあ！
あの虫が這い回る感触……
うぅっ、
寒気がっ……！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Hahaha!
Still as amusing now as it was back then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは……
はははははっ！
今思い返しても笑えてくるわっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hey! You had your own issues with them, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イリヤだって、
虫にイライラしてたさー！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, but only because they dared to suck my blood!
Mere bugs, hoping for a taste of the legendary vampire herself!
Unbelievable! Meanwhile, you seemed to be having no issues at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれは、
虫ごときがわらわの血を吸おうとしたからじゃ！
よりにもよって、
この伝説のヴァンパイアのわらわの血を……！
それなのに、
カオリは一人涼しい顔をしおって……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
And with that part of the journey over,
we came here in search of a replacement for an udon rolling pin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして、
『ゴーヤーっぽいもの』を見つけて、
次は『うどん用麺棒』を探しに
ここに来はったんやなあ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Which reminds me.
Why did you deem goya veggies and an udon rolling pin
as suitable replacements for garlic and a wooden stake?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
それにしても……
なぜニンニクが『ゴーヤーっぽいもの』で、
白木の杭が『うどん用麺棒』になったのじゃ？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
We talked it out for a bit and decided that a legendary vampire 
was gonna need something equally legendary to defeat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
伝説のヴァンパイアを相手にするんだから、
もっとすごいもので対抗しなきゃかなって思って、
二人で決めたさ～

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Not to rain on your parade,
but you never would have defeated me with those!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言っておくが、
わらわは『ゴーヤーっぽいもの』も
『うどん用麺棒』も効かぬぞ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
I [i]do[/i] appreciate the warped taste required
to reach that conclusion, however. Haha...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
そのセンス……
ふふっ……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Hey! We were serious about it!
text_block_list.orig_text: うちらは真剣やったのにな～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aye! Serious as can be!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうさー
本気だったさー！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
What if the two of you actually
appeared before me with those in hand...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしそれを持って
二人がわらわの前に現れていたら……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... Ahahaha!
Goodness! Just the thought has me in hysterics!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふっ……
はーっはっはっはっは！
いかん！　
笑いが止まらぬぞ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
W-we probably couldn't have, though.
It'd have been mighty difficult to tell
who you are when you're in kid form!
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも、
イリヤはんかて
子供の姿のまんまやったら、
うちら絶対わからなかったどす！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Oof... I don't assume that form by choice, I'll have you know!
Reverting to my original form requires hugging
{0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……
子供の姿は別に好き好んでなっていたわけではないぞ！
大人になるためには、
{0}に
抱き着かねばならぬのじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: 'Tis a cruel world we live in. Truly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
世の中は理不尽じゃ……
まったく。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
All that said, though.
Our journey was an eventful one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
いい旅じゃった……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: A real fun one!
text_block_list.orig_text: いい旅だったさ～！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Aye. Mighty fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん。
ほんまですわあ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Now then. It's about time we all return ho—
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
とりあえずみなで帰って……

text_block_list.name: Garoog
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
What the—?! Blast!
You dragged yourself all the way back up here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにっ！？　
貴様は……
まさか、
自力で穴から這い上がって来たというのか！？

text_block_list.name: Garoog
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Urgh! I won't make it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ！　
反応が、遅れた！！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaahhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: とりゃああああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Garoog
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOOGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Kaori?!
Thank you! I owe you one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリ！？　
すまぬ、
助かったぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
No sweat! I just did what friends do!
Right, Maho?
text_block_list.orig_text:
友達を助けるのは当然さー！　
ねっ、マホ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
You betcha. Ain't no one who wants to see
their dear friends get hurt! As for you, li'l monster,
you've done crossed the line.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せやねぇ、
大切な友達が傷つくのは、
見てられへんからなあ。
魔物はん、
ちょっとおいたがすぎるようやねえ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Of course.
The three of us are friends, all on equal footing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ、
そうか……
わらわたちは主従の関係ではなく、
友であったな……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Come, trusted companions!
This beast dares stand before us once more,
so let us show it the full extent of our might!
text_block_list.orig_text:
行こうぞ
盟友たちよ！　
おのが武を存分に振るおうぞ！
我らの前に立ちはだかる愚か者を、
打ち砕くのじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: W-woo! We did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やったさー！
　
魔物を倒したさー！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Indeed. And it's all thanks to your help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ……
二人が協力してくれたおかげじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Never thought we'd be able to defeat a monster that strong...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちらで、
あんなすごい魔物を倒せたんやなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
It's 'cause the three of us were together!
The power of friendship!
choice_data_list: It was actually four of us...
text_block_list.orig_text:
一人でも、二人でもダメだったさ！
　
３人だったからできたさーね！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
And who might that be?
Please, do remind me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　誰のことじゃ？
　他に誰かいたかのう？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Oh! How could I ever forget about my prince!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ、
王子はんのこと
すっかり忘れてたわー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oops! Sorry!
You played a big part in that, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんごめん！
　
{0}もいてくれたから勝てたさ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Well.
I suppose it's only fair to give credit where credit is due.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
ここは素直に礼を言っておくかのう。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait a minute.
Illya, you're, uh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ？
　その姿……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What the?!
When did I return to this form?!
After depleting my magical reserves?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　おぉっ！？
　子供に戻っておる！
魔力を使い果たしたせいか！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Well, we can't let a kid wander around at night.
So come on over to our guildhouse!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はもう遅いし、
子供が一人夜道を歩くのは危険さ！
私たちのギルドハウスに来るさー！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
You'd be most welcome.
And we'll treat you like a mighty fine guest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
改めて、
お客はんとして、
招待しますよって！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I see no reason to decline.
All the more so considering our previous promise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか。
ではせっかくだし世話になろうかのう。
ごちそうというのも、
約束じゃしな！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus, with precious new bonds formed,
the crew make their way back to town to celebrate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
旅を通じて、大切な絆を手にした３人。
新たな友情のはじまりを祝うため、街へと戻るのだった。
